hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the template u(x)*v(x)*u(x) by substituting the function symbol u, the function symbol v, and the variable symbol x from each instance map.
required_assumptions: Multiplication is the standard symbolic product in the expression; V, G0, W, H0 are unary functions of the indicated variable.
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands share the same sandwich/monomial form u(x)*v(x)*u(x), differing only by the outer function, inner function, and variable name. No physical interpretation is assumed.
